entry: Fixed the mobile Advance Season button clipping off the right edge of the screen on narrow phones.

New optional City Views panel: a dense numbers dashboard, a top-down civic map of your buildings (a distinct shape per building type), and a Sankey-style resource flow diagram showing how last season's work became food, materials, tools and knowledge.

New: a settlement archive (file your city's stats and a picture of its 3D view in a gallery kept on this device, with delete and clear) and a downloadable shareable card image, both inside the Civilization Summary.

New optional Consulting mode: take over a struggling pre-built city (the Smokestack City or the Sprawling Suburbs) and hold a Steady score for three seasons within thirty. Only offered before you play a season.

Second civic-backlog wave: an isometric camera preset and a pinnable time-of-day light, branch filter chips and exact effects plus unlock estimates on research nodes, a stakeholder-style summary with a Bronze/Silver/Gold efficiency rank, a keyboard shortcuts sheet (press ?), an opt-in community benchmark, a Founder's Log and a time-played readout.

New: optional Civic Challenges (opt-in constraints like taking 20% less from the land, for a knowledge reward), an 'Your city vs. history' chart with a real-world GDP-per-person reference line and its source, a livability-vs-population scatter, nine new research nodes, and small readouts (founded year, output per person, calm-season streak, tree completion).
Research panel decluttered: only nodes you can study right now stay in view; Locked and Known discoveries fold into collapsible sections (searching opens them automatically).
New: civilization summary report, three starting scenarios, an opt-in Hard Mode, a snapshot-to-PNG button for the 3D view, and subtle seasonal lighting.
Mobile: the Advance Season button now docks to the bottom of the screen, plus a site-wide body-padding cascade bug fixed so the dock no longer covers page content.
Settings panel: adjustable text size and a Reduce Motion toggle, consolidated into one panel.
Distinct building meshes for Sanitation Works, plus three named camera presets (Overview/Close-up/Aerial).
Research tree gained a search/filter box for its 40+ nodes.
Achievements added: 19 achievements, in-game panel, unlock toast, hub dashboard link, plus a new "Look Back" UI for revisiting completed eras.
Linked into the main hub nav — title card and review widget, same as every other game.
Visual pass: real low-poly Three.js 3D scenes for all seven eras, a WebGL-unavailable 2D fallback, adjustable text size, and a colorblind-safety audit.

Save/security audit: found and fixed six real save-robustness bugs, including an era-restoration crash, adversarial numeric values, a NaN/Infinity gap, a growth-loop page-freeze, and revisit cross-contamination.
Space Age era added: habitat capacity becomes a new fourth livability provision. All seven eras are now complete.
Digital era added: Urban Planners and Transit Hubs, with a new urban-sprawl mechanic — the flagship SDG 11 era.
Industrial era added: Factory Workers and Sanitation Works, with a pollution mechanic — the first era where growth and livability trade off directly, not just on the score.
Medieval era added: Guildmasters and Public Works, with the research tree's first resilience-side sustainability bonus.
Classical era added: Administrators and Canals, with a resilience-side sustainability adjustment.
Story and era-transition framework: ongoing logs, era-transition beats, and the first full Tribal to Agrarian transition.
Foundation shipped: the Tribal-era city simulation, sustainability/livability scoring, the continuous research tree, the save system, and the info-panel shell.
